_howto: One guide per archetype id. difficulty: Easy | Medium | Hard. Lunar team stats are unverified, check them.

freeze.hook: Lock the whole room in ice, then hit it safely.
steps: Hydro applicator uses skill and burst to keep enemies wet.
Cryo carry applies Cryo so wet enemies freeze.
Hit frozen enemies with the carry; Anemo groups them and shreds resistance.
freeze.rotation: Hydro skill and burst, then Anemo skill and burst, then Cryo carry skill and burst, then attack. Re-apply Hydro when the freeze drops.
freeze.stats: Carry: Crit, ATK%, Cryo DMG goblet. Hydro applicator: ER. Anemo: ER, EM.

vaporize_dps.hook: One Pyro or Hydro carry hitting for huge numbers.
steps: Off-field applicator puts the opposite element on enemies.
Swap to the carry and hit so Vaporize triggers on every attack.
Re-apply with the applicator when the aura runs out.
vaporize_dps.rotation: Applicator skill and burst, then buffer burst, then carry skill, burst and normal or charged attacks. Repeat when cooldowns return.
vaporize_dps.stats: Carry: Crit, ATK%, EM, element DMG goblet. Applicators: ER.

melt_dps.hook: Pyro on a Cryo aura for the biggest multipliers.
steps: Cryo applicator puts a Cryo aura on enemies.
Pyro carry hits while the aura is up to trigger forward Melt.
Re-apply Cryo before each burst window; timing is the skill.
melt_dps.rotation: Cryo skill, then support buff, then Pyro carry skill and burst inside the Cryo window, then attack.
melt_dps.stats: Carry: Crit, ATK%, EM, Pyro DMG goblet. Cryo applicator: ER.

overload.hook: Electro and Pyro explosions that blast enemies back.
steps: Pyro and Electro characters apply their elements.
Overload triggers on hit and damages every enemy nearby.
Bennett or Chevreuse buffs the team; a healer keeps it safe.
overload.rotation: Buffer burst, then Pyro skill and burst, then Electro skill and burst, then attack.
overload.stats: Carry: Crit, ATK%, element DMG. Some EM helps Overload damage. Off-fielders: ER.

aggravate.hook: Nahida makes every Electro hit land far harder.
steps: Nahida applies Dendro with her skill.
Electro applies Electro to create Quicken.
Carry hits for Aggravate (Electro) or Spread (Dendro).
aggravate.rotation: Nahida skill, then healer or shielder, then Electro skill and burst, then carry skill and burst, then attack.
aggravate.stats: EM is the key stat on both Nahida and the carry. Carry: Crit, Dendro or Electro DMG goblet. Raiden also wants ER.

bloom_core.hook: Chain Bloom cores into a constant area explosion.
steps: Hydro and Dendro applicators keep both elements on enemies.
Cores form on every reaction.
Nilou's skill and burst keep the cores bursting.
bloom_core.rotation: Dendro and Hydro skills, then supporter burst, then Nilou skill and burst, then attack.
bloom_core.stats: Nilou: HP%, EM, Crit. Nahida: EM. Hydro applicator: ER.

lunar_charged.hook: Nod-Krai's Lunar Electro-Charged, with a tight cast.
steps: Keep Hydro and Electro on enemies so Electro-Charged is active.
Lunar supports enable and buff the Lunar reaction.
The Lunar DPS hits to trigger the empowered reaction.
lunar_charged.rotation: Supports skill and burst first, then Hydro flex, then main DPS skill and burst, then attack.
lunar_charged.stats: Lunar-Charged damage scales with ATK, so ATK%, Crit and ER are likely right. Verify this.

wanderer_team.hook: Wanderer floats and melts everything with charged attacks.
steps: Faruzan uses skill and burst to buff charged attacks (needs C6 for full buff).
Wanderer uses his burst and enters Windfavored.
Spam charged attacks in the air while the buffs last.
wanderer_team.rotation: Faruzan skill and burst, then buffer burst, then Wanderer skill and burst, then charged attacks.
wanderer_team.stats: Wanderer: Crit, ATK%, Anemo DMG goblet, enough ER. Faruzan: ER.

lunar_bloom.hook: Nefer turns Dendro cores into Lunar-Bloom.
steps: Lauma and the Hydro applicator create Dendro cores.
Lauma's enabling turns them into Lunar-Bloom.
Nefer hits with charged attacks to deal heavy damage.
lunar_bloom.rotation: Hydro skill, then Lauma skill and burst, then Nefer skill and burst, then charged attacks.
lunar_bloom.stats: Lunar-Bloom scales with EM, so EM is likely the main stat on Nefer. Verify this.

xiao_plunge.hook: Xiao dives from the sky again and again.
steps: Xianyun skill gives him lift and boosts his plunges.
Anemo support shreds resistance; shielder covers his HP drain.
Xiao uses burst, then keeps plunging until it ends.
xiao_plunge.rotation: Shielder first, then Anemo support, then Xianyun skill, then Xiao burst and plunge repeatedly.
xiao_plunge.stats: Xiao: Crit, ATK%, Anemo DMG goblet, ER if short. Xianyun: ATK%, ER.

geo_resonance.hook: Two Geo characters stack shields and damage.
steps: Zhongli or Noelle sets up the shield first.
Geo supports use skill and burst for buffs and off-field damage.
Geo carry hits hard with the resonance bonus.
geo_resonance.rotation: Shielder, then supports, then carry skill and burst, then attack.
geo_resonance.stats: Itto and Chiori scale on DEF, Navia on ATK. Supports: ER, plus DEF% or ATK% as their kit needs.

lunar_crystallize.hook: Geo and Hydro shards, turned Lunar by a Moonsign character.
steps: Geo and Hydro make Crystallize shards.
Linnea powers and heals the team; a Moonsign character turns shards Lunar.
Geo carry hits for strong Lunar-Crystallize.
lunar_crystallize.rotation: Hydro applicator, then Linnea, then Geo support, then carry skill and burst, then attack.
lunar_crystallize.stats: Lunar-Crystallize likely scales with DEF, so DEF%, Crit and ER may be best. Verify this.

stellar_conduct.hook: Sandrone's own Cryo reaction, with a big ATK buff.
steps: Nicole or Bennett goes first to put the ATK buff on the team.
Your Electro or Cryo partner (Yae Miko, Cyno, Wriothesley) uses its skill so Stellar-Conduct can trigger.
Swap to Sandrone for her burst and charged attacks.
stellar_conduct.rotation: Buffer skill and burst, then partner skill (and burst if it is a DPS), then Sandrone skill and burst, then charged attacks.
stellar_conduct.stats: Sandrone scales on ATK: Crit, ATK%, and enough ER for her burst. Her Stellar-Conduct damage doesn't use the Cryo DMG goblet, so don't prioritize it. Nicole: ATK%, ER. Verify this.

burning_kinich.hook: Keep everything burning while Kinich does the real damage.
steps: Pyro applicator uses its skill to keep Pyro on enemies.
A Dendro source (Nahida, Baizhu or Kinich himself) keeps Dendro on enemies so Burning triggers.
Nicole or Bennett buffs ATK, then Kinich fights from the front.
burning_kinich.rotation: Pyro applicator skill and burst, then Dendro support, then buffer, then Kinich skill, burst and attacks.
burning_kinich.stats: Kinich: Crit, ATK%, Dendro DMG goblet, EM if it helps Burning. Pyro applicator: ER. Nicole: ATK%, ER. Verify this.
